research.name: fzf-make
research.note: Fuzzy finder TUI for make, npm, pnpm, yarn, just and task that previews the selected target's source before running it.

effects: syntax-highlighted preview pane that jumps to the selected target's definition line in the Makefile as you fuzzy-filter
three-pane layout with Targets and History tabs switched by tab key above a search box and key hint bar
